description: Issue #824 cross-vendor review Finding 1: neutralizes DCExtension.IsFileAttachmentPrincipal -- the ONE shared comparison both IsFileAttachmentForeignKeyProperty and FileAttachmentSaveChangesGuard.BuildMap call (extracted in the PR #978 review follow-up specifically so the two consumers cannot drift again) -- with a compile-preserving revert to the pre-fix exact-type comparison (`principalClrType == typeof(FileAttachment)`, never a deletion), so a relationship whose principal is a class DERIVED from FileAttachment (TPH/TPT subclass) is no longer recognized as an attachment FK by EITHER consumer. This entry checks it against FileAttachmentForeignKeyPredicateDerivedPrincipalTests824's TPH predicate-level test; the sibling entry dcext824-derived-principal-neutralize-guard-kill checks the SAME patch against the guard's own end-to-end SaveChanges test, proving one shared implementation protects both code paths. green_tests is IsFileAttachmentForeignKeyProperty_UnrelatedProperty_NonDerivedPrincipal_ReturnsFalse (#986 fix): it queries ProductWithOptionalPhoto.ID via BypassGuardContext824, whose only FK (PhotoId) targets FileAttachment itself, not a derived subclass -- IsFileAttachmentPrincipal(typeof(FileAttachment)) returns true identically under both the real IsAssignableFrom comparison and the mutant's exact-type comparison, so the FK always reaches the same unchanged property-name loop and the assertion's outcome is provably invariant to this mutation. #986 replaced the PRIOR green_test (IsFileAttachmentForeignKeyProperty_UnrelatedProperty_ReturnsFalse), which reused this class's own InvoiceTph824/SignedFileTph824 TPH fixture -- the SAME derived-principal FK the mutant targets -- so under the mutant it returned false via a DIFFERENT control path (skipped at the IsFileAttachmentPrincipal gate, never reaching the property-name comparison) instead of the intended path, passing silently for the wrong reason. See .claude/rules/testing.md's positive-control-coupling rule for the general pattern (issue #986).
target_symbol: DCExtension.IsFileAttachmentPrincipal(Type?) -- the shared derived-principal IsAssignableFrom comparison, line ~250
